recipes.name: Coconut dhal with turmeric
recipes.method_note: Creamier and milder than a north Indian dhal. Good for children.

steps.instruction: Rinse {{ing:lentils-red-dry}}. Put in a pan with 600 ml water and {{ing:turmeric-ground}}.
Simmer (small bubbles) 15 minutes, until soft.
Stir in {{ing:coconut-milk-tinned}}. Simmer 5 minutes more.
Cook {{ing:rice-basmati-dry}} following the packet.
Slice {{ing:onion-medium}}. Crush {{ing:garlic-clove}}. Grate {{ing:ginger-fresh}}. Slice {{ing:chilli-fresh}}.
Fry them in {{ing:vegetable-oil}} 8 minutes, until the onion is golden.
Stir in {{ing:curry-powder}}. Cook 1 minute.
Tip the onion mix into the dhal. Stir in {{ing:spinach}} until wilted.
Serve with the rice.

swaps.text: Kale or chard; give them 2 minutes longer

recipes.name: Sri Lankan-style chicken curry
recipes.method_note: Toasting the curry powder in the dry pan first deepens the flavour.

steps.instruction: Toast {{ing:curry-powder}} in a dry pan for 1 minute, until it smells nutty.
Cut {{ing:chicken-thigh-boneless}} into chunks. Toss with the toasted powder.
Slice {{ing:onion-medium}}. Crush {{ing:garlic-clove}}. Grate {{ing:ginger-fresh}}.
Heat {{ing:vegetable-oil}} in a large pan. Fry the onion 10 minutes, until golden.
Add garlic, ginger and {{ing:cinnamon-ground}}. Fry 1 minute.
Add the chicken. Fry 5 minutes, until sealed.
Add {{ing:chopped-tomatoes-tinned}} and {{ing:coconut-milk-tinned}}.
Simmer (small bubbles) 25 minutes, until the chicken is tender.
Cook {{ing:rice-basmati-dry}} following the packet.
Squeeze in the juice of {{ing:lime}}. Serve with the rice.

swaps.text: Firm tofu or a tin of chickpeas, for a vegetarian version

recipes.name: Green beans with coconut
recipes.method_note: A side dish in Sri Lanka. With rice and an egg it is lunch.

steps.instruction: Slice {{ing:green-beans}} into short lengths. Chop {{ing:onion-medium}}.
Heat {{ing:vegetable-oil}} in a wide pan on a medium heat.
Fry the onion 5 minutes, until soft.
Add the beans, {{ing:turmeric-ground}}, {{ing:chilli-powder}} and {{ing:salt}}.
Stir-fry 6 minutes, until tender but still bright.
Stir in {{ing:desiccated-coconut}}. Cook 1 minute.
Squeeze over {{ing:lime}} to serve.
